Although the concept of spiking insulin is logical in theory, the need to do so post-exercise ultimately depends on when food was consumed pre-exercise. The impact of insulin on net muscle protein balance plateaus at 3 to 4 times fasting levels (a range of approximately 15 to 30 mU/L) (48, 1 13). Typical mixed meals achieve this effect 1 to 2 hours after consumption, and levels remain elevated for 3 to 6 hours (or more) depending on the size of the meal.
